title: Unicode text layout: code-point offsets, soft hyphens, and alignment
statement:
# Unicode-aware text layout (`src/`)

The package measures, wraps, hyphenates, aligns, and renders text. Width and offsets are measured in Unicode code points; soft hyphens are invisible and do not increase width. For justified lines, distribute remainder spaces from the left. A soft-hyphen break must split at the actual soft-hyphen position, and rendering must slice by code-point offsets. Preserve all current exports and options.

bugs.summary: Remainder spaces are assigned to the rightmost gaps instead of the leftmost gaps.
Soft hyphens are counted as visible characters when calculating later break points.
Width counts UTF-16 code units instead of Unicode code points.
Rendering slices text with UTF-16 offsets although wrapping returns code-point offsets.
Wrapping records UTF-16 positions and treats visible hyphen points as direct slice indices.
